newsitem.title: FRANCE: France will keep majority stake in France Telecom.
newsitem.headline: France will keep majority stake in France Telecom.

text.p: The French state will keep a majority stake in telecommunications operator France Telecom SA, the Finance Ministry said Friday in the clearest indications so far that it is willing to sell a minority stake.

Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn said in a letter to Michel Delebarre, appointed on Thursday to lead a wide consultation at France Telecom, that "France Telecom will keep its current status and thus a majority state shareholding."

"This public company will fulfil all the public services specified by the law, with strict respect for equality and universal access," a spokeswoman for the ministry said, quoting Delebarre's letter of mission.

The previous conservative government had planned to sell about 35 percent of France Telecom in the country's biggest initial public offering. The company was estimated to be worth 160-210 billion francs ($26-$35 billion).

The operation, initially due in May, was postponed by a month after President Jacques Chirac called an early parliamentary election and then suspended after the Socialist party formed a government with the Communists and Greens.
